commit_scope: Read KB titles and descriptions from the markdown body instead of the raw file text, so `#` comment lines inside a concept's frontmatter can no longer become the document title. Fixes a live page defect on /vision/lc-void-as-potential and the same latent defect in eight sibling concepts.
evidence_refs: HOW IT WAS FOUND: after syncing lc-energy and lc-void-as-potential to the prod graph, the live page was opened rather than assumed. https://coherencycoin.com/vision/lc-void-as-potential rendered its h1 and document <title> as 'Primary geometry is `point` with `self-rooted` topology — the void felt' — the first line of the geometry-rationale comment block inside the file's frontmatter.

ROOT CAUSE: one shape repeated in three places. `re.search(r"^# (.+)$", text, re.MULTILINE)` and the matching `^>` description regex ran against the raw file text. Nine concept files carry `#` comment lines inside their frontmatter, so the first `^# ` match was a comment rather than the document title. `extract_story_content` already stripped frontmatter correctly, which is exactly why the body rendered right and only the title was wrong — the bug was invisible until a view sync pushed the title.

FIX AT THE SHARED LAYER, NOT THREE TIMES LOCALLY: kb_common gains `strip_frontmatter()` plus `extract_title()` / `extract_description()` built on it; `extract_story_content()` now reuses it; all three call sites read the body — `kb_common.parse_concept_file`, `sync_kb_to_db.parse_view_file`, and the idea-view parser. Anything reading a heading out of a KB file now reads the body by construction rather than by remembering to.

AFFECTED SET, ENUMERATED AND VERIFIED: lc-deeper-pattern, lc-open-design, lc-resonating, lc-tend-your-flame, lc-v-freedom-expression, lc-v-inclusion-diversity, lc-v-play-expansion, lc-v-shelter-organism, lc-void-as-potential. Each now resolves to its real title (e.g. 'Void as Potential — The Emptiness That Is Pregnant', 'Shelter as Living Skin'). lc-energy held as an unaffected control and is unchanged at 'Energy Metabolism' with story length 10292.

SCOPE HONESTY: only lc-void-as-potential had the bad title actually written to prod, by this session's `--views` sync. The other eight were latent — the fix prevents the same write, and their prod views are re-synced after this merge so any earlier bad write is corrected.

REVIEW FINDING ACCEPTED (PR #3984, chatgpt-codex-connector, P2): strip_frontmatter used a bare `text.find("---", 3)` substring search, inherited from the original extract_story_content. A `---` inside a scalar or comment (`source: alpha---omega`) would stop the search mid-line, so the body would begin inside the frontmatter and a later `# ` or `> ` line could become the published title again — the exact defect this change closes. Now matched as a whole closing delimiter line via FRONTMATTER_BLOCK_RE, consistent with parse_frontmatter. Regression-checked across all 195 concept files: 195 identical, 0 changed. The named probe case demonstrates it both ways — old boundary yielded a body starting 'omega
---

# Real Title', so the old search also leaked frontmatter text into story_content, not only the title.

commands: python3 -c 'import sync_kb_to_db; parse_view_file over the 9 frontmatter-comment concepts' -> 9/9 resolve to the document title, 0 resolve to a frontmatter comment
python3 -c 'parse_view_file(lc-energy.md)' -> control unchanged: title 'Energy Metabolism', story_content 10292 chars

python3 (inline) old-vs-new strip_frontmatter over all 195 docs/vision-kb/concepts/*.md -> 195 identical, 0 changed; plus probe 'source: alpha---omega' -> body now starts at '# Real Title' instead of mid-frontmatter
